March 2 - NASA's administrator-general (the United States space agency), Daniel Goldin, visited the facilities of the National Institute for Space Research (Inpe) and signed space cooperation agreements between the two institutions. Such agreements had existed in the past, but this was the first time NASA's top official had come to the country to see its scientific facilities. Civilians and military personnel following the Varginha Case believe that Daniel Goldin's and Warren Christopher's presence in Brazil involves agreements concerning the beings captured in Varginha. It would also be a way to "justify" the presence at Unicamp of military personnel who work within NASA.

After listening to the girls, they said they were the girls' "gold mine." In a major attempt at bribery, they offered enough money to fulfill the girls' dreams in exchange for recording a video in which Liliane and Valquíria would say they had not seen any strange creature and that it had all been a prank. We do not know whether these four individuals were military personnel, religious fanatics, or someone "testing" the girls.
